name: EffiBench-X
description: EffiBench-X is a multi-language benchmark designed to measure the efficiency of LLM-generated code across six programming languages. It includes competitive programming tasks with human-expert solutions as efficiency baselines, highlighting the gap between model-generated code and human efficiency.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark for measuring code efficiency rather than just correctness, with limited but growing awareness in the code-generation research community.
notes: Focuses on code efficiency across multiple languages rather than just functional correctness.
